purpose: M0a corrected small native inference and backward smoke: prove writer/sense/action producers are detached in inference before measuring the selected 4096-unit workload. No quality claim and no optimizer update.

scope.training: modules_only backward; no optimizer step; base frozen

measurements: writer_requires_grad and sense_requires_grad are false at every inference point
source encode, writer, sense, forward, generation, prepare and backward seconds
sampled MPS allocated/driver bytes and process RSS
stop_conditions: writer_requires_grad or sense_requires_grad is true in inference
schedule point raises an unexpected error

acceptance.accept_if: both points complete, inference producers are detached, logits/loss/gradients finite, and guard completes
acceptance.reject_or_defer_if: any stop condition fires; do not proceed to 4096

retention: Keep run/failure report, progress, profile and guard traces. No base copy, optimizer checkpoint or download.
claims: Corrected autograd and bounded native capacity smoke only; no memory quality, generalization or architecture-benefit claim.
